objective: Consolidated Community Wall patch: compact collapsed post entry, shared posts, reactions, one-line captions, Android original-photo upgrades.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: independent production release evidence recorded in PR #515 identifies Android OTA 01a1afda-304b-72a7-a859-8799f25ac602 on runtime 1.3.2 and source 8e1956e617a65b3350b3fba81597fc86604da4a1. The main branch is a DEV integration baseline, not automatic proof of the installed APK; this PR has no production or staging OTA.
chosenApproach: Reconcile current main, prior UI and Android-only photo fixes; use compact one-tap composer entry with post-render autofocus and preserve canonical gallery. Constrain the reaction picker to its own 46px action column so the Like label remains visible.
selectionRationale: Composes existing renderers in a shared shell and extends platform-specific image cache promotion. Avoids merging diverged branches or overwriting main video/photo paths.
preserveBehaviors: Public and scoped photo collages, videos, signed URLs and caches unchanged
All composer actions, reaction and comment controls unchanged
No feed pagination, scroll reset, ads, navigation or authorization modification
No backend, RLS, native dependency, runtime or production OTA modification
Current main Community Wall collage and Marites video renderer, signed media, ads, auth, pagination, posting flow and backend stay unchanged
Existing long-press reaction picker, share RPC, comments and all Reels controls unchanged
Composer intent activation and prefilled drafts remain functional, with unchanged submit, media picker, mention, audience and moderation controls
acceptanceChecks: Media posts show one compact caption line before expansion
Long captions expose accessible inline See more and See less
Text-only posts up to 80 Unicode code points render as enlarged type
Public and Organization/Sub-organization/Cluster use the same component
Regression coverage passes on the exact branch head
Caption expansion never replaces list keys, scroll anchors, pagination or refresh callbacks
Public and scoped Wall share one modern feed card without duplicated card padding
Android original-ready signals wake mounted tiles, retaining private URL isolation
Original transfer slot releases on valid decode without falsely marking onDisplay
Combined Android and Wall rendering regression tests pass before staging integration
Both post feeds expose Like/Comment/Share in one accessible action row without duplicate Comment/Share buttons
Public and scoped Wall show compact single-row post entry when empty; one tap opens canonical editor, photos use canonical gallery, Reels and drafts stay expanded
Social action row allocates visible space for all three labels and keeps the Like picker touch area accessible
One-tap text entry focuses after the expanded composer mounts; photo picker does not trigger keyboard autofocus
alternativeApproaches: Replace the full Wall feed card (rejected: risks media and scroll regressions)
Truncate captions at 280 characters (rejected: does not honor one-line preview)
Create separate Public and scoped caption renderers (rejected: causes drift)
